purpose: Immutable release-candidate snapshot fixing the N00 schema blocker found only after rc3 (session 019ffcc7-a48f-7870-a933-5d80bb61dac3) reached QA_PASSED / chain_valid true and was approved by exact digest in contracts/spec_approval.v1.yaml: plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/schemas/spec_approval.schema.v1.json -- the parent v1 Run 27 package's own frozen approval schema -- const-locks approved_spec to the parent package's own spec, a path this package's approved specification v4 can never equal, so N00 could never actually validate an approval record against it; N00_spec_approval_gate.prompt.v4.md's TEST step 6 additionally misclaimed that schema as frozen per this package's own rules.frozen_before_entry, which it never was. This snapshot adds a package-scoped schemas/spec_approval.schema.v2.json, a contracts/spec_approval.v2.yaml carrying forward (not reinventing) the exact already-approved digests and model decision as schema-validated structured fields, implementation.graph.v5.yaml (a gate-lineage rename of v4 declaring schema v2 in its own rules.frozen_before_entry), N00_spec_approval_gate.prompt.v5.md (validates against schema v2, states the frozen claim accurately), and mechanical gate-lineage renames of N20_provider_transport.prompt.v5.md / N30_preflight_egress.prompt.v5.md (needed because the graph's own filename changed under them).

corrects_post_approval_defect.note: rc3 itself is not at fault and is not reopened, edited, or overridden: its own QA criteria correctly covered graph/scanner/validator/prompt internal consistency. The defect this snapshot fixes -- a cross-package schema-compatibility fact -- was outside rc1/rc2/rc3's criteria and was found only when N00 was actually attempted against the resulting, already-approved package.
